orgDesign.companyProfile: Global hosted-stays marketplace centered on guest demand, host supply, professional operations, trust, payments, and compliance.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Guest-facing teams own discovery, booking, and trip confidence. Host-facing teams own activation, listing quality, pricing, and portfolio operations. Shared trust, payment, compliance, and intelligence teams provide marketplace control functions.
designPrinciples: Keep guest trust and host quality inside the same operating system because both sides affect marketplace conversion.
Treat AirCover, payments, support, and compliance as shared platform capabilities with dedicated ownership.
Separate everyday host simplicity from professional operator depth while preserving one marketplace core.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for guest marketplace, host growth, professional supply operations, and marketplace foundations.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
